bladVersie.rekenversieUitleg: Calc version {{versie}}: a fingerprint of this sheet's calculation text. It is printed as well, so you can later trace which version was used.

statusUitleg.gereed: Module calibrated — checks verified against reference sheets
statusUitleg.controleren: Module to be checked — checks worked out, not yet verified against reference sheets
statusUitleg.raming: Quantities hand-checked — no structural strength check
statusUitleg.concept: Module to be worked out — input and parametric view only, no checks

bladVersie.meldingUitleg: this sheet calculates with version {{oud}}, the module is now at {{nieuw}}. The sheet only changes when you update it yourself.
bladVersie.meldingEigen: this sheet came from version {{bron}} and was edited afterwards (now {{oud}}); the module is now at {{nieuw}}. Updating replaces your modification with the new module text.
bladVersie.eigenUitleg: Own modification: the calculation text of this sheet has been edited and differs from version {{bron}} of the module it came from.
bladVersie.eigenUit: Sheets with their own modification are unticked: updating would discard that modification.
bladVersie.eigenWaarschuwing: This sheet was edited after it was inserted (source: calc version {{bron}}). Updating replaces the entire calculation text with the new module text: your own modification is lost. Re-apply it afterwards if needed; Undo (Ctrl+Z) restores the sheet.
bladVersie.alleUitleg: Compare and update the sheets that have a newer calc version
bladVersie.introEen: The sheet has been calculated with its current input, using the old and the new calc version.
bladVersie.introAlle: Each sheet has been calculated with its current input, using the old and the new calc version. Untick what you do not want to update.
bladVersie.geenVerouderd: All sheets already use the latest calc version.
bladVersie.veldenGelijk: Same input fields; all input is kept.
bladVersie.beeldVult: A new field without a value calculates here with its initial value; the parametric view may fill in its own default when the sheet is opened.
bladVersie.letOp: Updating replaces the sheet's calculation text with the new version and keeps the input that still exists. Your own changes to the sheet's code are lost. Undo (Ctrl+Z) restores everything.
